title: Resilience & Hope
intro: The first year has its own griefs — colic, illness, a birth that did not go to plan, a family under more strain than anyone expected. This month does not pretend otherwise. It says that hard seasons pass, that God is nearest to the exhausted, and that hope is a reasonable thing to hold at 3am.

keyScriptures.text: Because of the Lord's great love we are not consumed... they are new every morning.
The Lord is close to the broken-hearted.

weeks.title: This Season Will Pass
weeks.declaration: Whatever is hard about right now, it is a season and not a shape. It will pass, and something else will be hard instead.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, give us perspective at 3am. Remind us that this will not always be now. Amen.

weeks.title: Near the Exhausted
weeks.declaration: God does not stand back from tired people. He comes closer, and He is not disappointed in us.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Lord, be close to us in this. We are more tired than we know how to say. Amen.

weeks.title: Help Is Not Failure
weeks.declaration: Asking for help is not failing at this. It is how families have always survived a first year.
weeks.parentsPrayer: God, give us the humility to ask, and send us people who can be asked. Amen.

weeks.title: Hope Is Reasonable
weeks.declaration: There is good ahead. Hoping for it is not naive; it is what people do who know how the story ends.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, keep hope alive in this house. Let our child grow up in a home that expects good things. Amen.

days.title: This Will Pass
days.declaration: Whatever is hard right now is a season, not a shape. It will pass.

scripture.text: There is a time for everything.

days.title: New Every Morning
days.declaration: However the night went, the morning starts again. That is a promise, not a platitude.

scripture.text: His mercies are new every morning.

days.title: Near the Exhausted
days.declaration: God comes closer to tired people rather than standing back from them.

scripture.text: The Lord is close to the broken-hearted.

days.title: Help Is Not Failure
days.declaration: Needing help is not failing. No family has ever done a first year alone.

scripture.text: Two are better than one.

days.title: Held When We Cannot Hold
days.declaration: On the days we cannot hold anything, you are still held. So are we.

scripture.text: I am the Lord your God who takes hold of your right hand.

days.title: Crying Is Not Broken
days.declaration: Crying does not mean something is broken. It means something is being said.

scripture.text: List my tears on your scroll.

days.title: Strength for Today Only
days.declaration: We are given today's strength today. That is why we can come back tomorrow.

scripture.text: Do not worry about tomorrow.

days.title: No Chart to Fail
days.declaration: You are not behind, whatever any chart says. You are on your own timetable.

scripture.text: My times are in your hands.

days.title: Rest Is Allowed
days.declaration: Rest is not a reward for coping well. It is part of surviving at all.

scripture.text: I will give you rest.

days.title: Illness Is Not Punishment
days.declaration: When you are unwell, it is not a judgement on anyone. It is a hard week.

scripture.text: Neither this man nor his parents sinned.

days.title: A Difficult Start Is Not the Story
days.declaration: However this began, it is not the whole story. Beginnings are not endings.

scripture.text: You intended to harm me, but God intended it for good.

days.title: Getting Through Counts
days.declaration: Some weeks getting through is the achievement. Count it as one.

scripture.text: Let us not become weary in doing good.

days.title: Grief Is Allowed Here
days.declaration: If something has been lost, it can be grieved out loud in this house.

scripture.text: Jesus wept.

days.title: Not the Only Ones
days.declaration: Whatever this is, we are not the only family in it. It only feels that way.

scripture.text: Nothing has overtaken you except what is common to mankind.

days.title: Small Steps Count
days.declaration: On a hard day, one small good thing is a real thing. It does not need to be more.

scripture.text: Do not despise these small beginnings.

days.title: Held Through the Night
days.declaration: The night will end. You will be kept through it and so will we.

scripture.text: Weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.

days.title: Hope Anchored
days.declaration: Hope here is not optimism. It is anchored to someone who does not move.

scripture.text: We have this hope as an anchor for the soul.

days.title: Nothing Wasted
days.declaration: None of this is being wasted, even the parts that make no sense now.

scripture.text: In all things God works for the good of those who love him.

days.title: Tell Someone
days.declaration: Saying it out loud to one person makes it smaller. That will be true all your life.

scripture.text: Carry each other's burdens.

days.title: Kind to Ourselves
days.declaration: We will speak to ourselves the way we would speak to a friend in this week.

scripture.text: Love your neighbour as yourself.

days.title: Not Ruined by a Bad Day
days.declaration: A bad day does not ruin you and it does not ruin us. Tomorrow still comes.

scripture.text: Though I have fallen, I will rise.

days.title: God Is Not Disappointed
days.declaration: God is not disappointed in tired parents. That is not who He is.

scripture.text: He knows how we are formed, he remembers that we are dust.

days.title: Made Stronger
days.declaration: What we are getting through is making us people who can carry more.

scripture.text: The testing of your faith produces perseverance.

days.title: A Record of Being Helped
days.declaration: Look back: we have been helped every hard week so far. That is evidence.

scripture.text: Thus far the Lord has helped us.

days.title: Comfort to Pass On
days.declaration: What we are learning now will be useful to someone else later. It is not only for us.

scripture.text: So that we can comfort those in any trouble.

days.title: The Middle Is Hard
days.declaration: Most stories are worst in the middle. We may simply be in the middle.

scripture.text: Wait for the Lord; be strong and take heart.

days.title: Good Comes Round
days.declaration: Good things come round again. This is not the last of them.

scripture.text: You turned my wailing into dancing.

days.title: Hope for You
days.declaration: We have hope for your whole life, not only for this week. It is bigger than the year.

scripture.text: Plans to give you hope and a future.

days.title: Carried, Not Dragged
days.declaration: We are being carried through this rather than dragging ourselves. There is a difference.

scripture.text: I have made you and I will carry you.

days.title: Still Being Made
days.declaration: None of us is finished. God does not abandon what He has started, in you or in us.

scripture.text: He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion.

days.title: Evidence for Later
days.declaration: We will remember this year as proof for the next hard one. Keep the proof.

scripture.text: Perseverance produces character; and character, hope.
